sections.title: Privacy at a glance.
sections.content: Find out what information is involved in shopping with us, how it is handled and where to ask questions.
sections.policyNote: Sample privacy policy — replace with your store’s approved content.

items.title: Information we collect
items.description:
Describe the information your store collects when someone shops, creates an account or contacts your team.

Add the actual details collected, such as order, delivery and customer support information.

items.title: How information is used
items.description:
Explain how information supports orders, delivery, account features and customer enquiries.

List the purposes that apply to your store and distinguish optional communications.

items.title: Service providers & sharing
items.description:
Describe the services involved in running your store, including payment, delivery and support.

Add your actual providers and explain what information is shared with each, where relevant.

items.title: Cookies & preferences
items.description:
Explain which cookies and similar technologies your website uses and what each category does.

Add your actual cookie categories and describe the available preference controls.

items.title: Retention & protection
items.description:
Describe how your store handles information over time and the measures used to protect it.

Add your approved retention approach. Avoid promising a fixed period or absolute security without confirmation.

items.title: Your choices & requests
items.description:
Help customers understand how to ask questions about their information or make a privacy request.

Describe the request process, identity checks and available choices that apply to your store.

items.title: Updates & contact
items.description:
Explain how customers can find the current policy and reach the team responsible for privacy enquiries.

Add your approved business contact channel and update process.
